gallery.contract: Review the gallery-media integration. Both dm.filament.gallery and m.gallery are received. Each gallery has valid media itemtypes; the gallery itself has no top-level url or file. Existing media callers must keep working with gallery MatrixEvents, while callers may also construct helpers directly from individual media content. Preserve media metadata, encrypted-media behavior and existing single-media behavior. The packet contains the helper, gallery conversion/validation, media resolution, and excerpts of existing callers. Report concrete current defects in this contract. Do not report future feature tasks or missing files that this packet does not establish.
